div.head: VII Atr 2.3
div.ab: Et sit omnis seruus liber ab opere illis tribus diebus, quo melius ieiunare possit, et operetur sibimet quod uult.
Et sit omnis servus liber ab opere illis tribus diebus, quo melius ieiunare possit, et operetur sibimet quod vult.
Et sit omnis servus liber ab opere illis tribus diebus, quo melius ieiunare possit, et operetur sibimet quod vult.
Und jeder Sklav sei frei von Arbeit an jenen drei Tagen, damit er besser fasten könne, und arbeite für sich, was er will.
And let every slave be free from work on those three days, so that he can fast better, and let him work for himself at what he wishes.
And all slaves shall be exempt from work on those three days, so that they can fast the better and may make what they want for themselves.
And all slaves are to be freed from work on those three days so that they will be able to fast better and make what they wish for themselves.
div.note: Liebermann compares VIIa Atr 5.1.; AZ: added from Rabin p. 182, October 2026 (Rabin’s note to the translation)
